content: My PR #33650 was accepted and the bors command was called, but there was a spurious build failiure and it's been stuck with the ready to merge tag for three days now.
If you're confident it's not your fault and you haven't changed anything about the pr since getting the approval (not merged master, for example), you can use bors retry
I think bors retry might be limited to members of the reviewer team?
Oh really? I didn't know that bors supported permissions between merge and nothing. In that case, read "I" for "you" :)
